title: Monroe city offices and courts to close for Veterans Day observance
text:
Government
Monroe city offices and courts to close for Veterans Day observance
City of Monroe offices and facilities will close on November 11 for Veterans Day. Trash collection remains unchanged while Transit and City Courts will also observe the closure.
Wednesday, Nov 4
By C. N. Aguilar
Mayor Friday Ellis announced on Nov. 4 that City of Monroe offices and facilities will be closed Wednesday, November 11, in observance of Veterans Day. Offices are scheduled to reopen Thursday, November 12.
Trash collection services will continue to operate on their regular schedule during the holiday closure period.
The announcement also stated that both Transit and Monroe City Courts will be closed on Wednesday, November 11. These services are expected to resume operations on Thursday, November 12.
No changes were indicated for other city services during the holiday.
